name: Apply a proposal
description: apply(proposal), in the library and as lastro apply <proposal>, refuses unless the proposal is approved, unchanged since approval, has no open decision, and every proof, new and regression, passes. It then writes each resulting use case (adds the use case file, replaces the description and name, or deletes the file of a removed use case), writes each passing proof to .lastro/proof/ as a regression test of its use case, deletes the files of the superseded proofs, appends the proposal id to each touched use case's history, records the new baseline hash in the receipt and sets the proposal's status to applied.
